description: P2 (1,10),(2,20) and C2 (1,1,'a'),(2,1,'b'),(3,2,'c') with a declared relationship C2.PID to P2.ID. Asks which source field each projected field maps to, whether the parent field of a one-to-many join is updatable under each option, and whether the change shows in all matching occurrences. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
